notes.subject: lasigili
notes.rationale: תבונה is understanding/insight, rendered with a Bambara compound 'lasigili' (deep perception)

notes.subject: kɔlɔsi
notes.rationale: Bambara requires an object for 'ma … layidu' construction, marked with ⟨…⟩

notes.subject: no narration / infinite
notes.rationale: אין מספר rendered as 'has no limit'; KJV 'infinite', YLT 'no narration' — literally 'there is no number'

translation: An ka Matigi ka bon, a fanga ka bon kosɛbɛ; a feko-dɔnni ma layidu <kɔlɔsi>. (Gadu) An ka Adonay bɛ bon, a se ka ca; a lasigili ma layidu (kɔlɔsi). — dɛmɛ don: Yawe tɔgɔ ma bɔ nin juma kɔnɔ.
